_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one part of the diagram read off (only one shape, or all three); 2: every number inside one or two shapes added; 3: parts inside some shapes and outside others added; 4: numbers changed first (doubled, or 2 added), or four shapes. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
